title.zh: 第二賽季｜Sacc 七曲 Downhill 錦標賽

summary.zh: 第二賽季第 7 站，Sacc 七曲 Downhill 路線錦標賽。本場特別開放新手友善場次，歡迎剛入門的車手一起參加。開始時間、詳細賽制與車輛限制請見下方時程與規則。
summary.en: Season 2 Round 7 on the Sacc Nanamagari Downhill route. This round is beginner-friendly — newer drivers are welcome to join. See the schedule and rules below for start time, format, and vehicle restrictions.

title.zh: 第二賽季｜CVS 神留坂計時賽

summary.zh: 第二賽季第 6 站，CVS 神留坂計時賽。神留坂是以高速彎與髮夾彎聞名的長程環狀山道，考驗車輛穩定性與煞車節奏。活動期間可不限次數挑戰，以世界 UI 的有效時間排序。
summary.en: Season 2 Round 6 at CVS Kamidomarizaka. Known for its high-speed corners and hairpin turns on a long circuit layout, it tests vehicle stability and braking rhythm. Drivers can make unlimited attempts during the session, ranked by valid world-UI times.

title.zh: 第二賽季｜CVS 鈴鹿賽道計時賽

summary.zh: 第二賽季第 5 站已結束，共 8 位車手挑戰鈴鹿 NASCAR '97 東賽道與 Grand Prix 全賽道。東賽道榜首為 Cannedcarbon（00:48.974），Grand Prix 榜首為 mrkamari.2026 86a8（02:02.153）。
summary.en: Season 2 Round 5 has concluded, with 8 drivers across Suzuka NASCAR '97 East Circuit and Grand Prix Circuit. Cannedcarbon led the East Circuit at 00:48.974; mrkamari.2026 86a8 led the Grand Prix Circuit at 02:02.153.

title.zh: 第二賽季｜Sacc 碓冰 V2 Counter-Clockwise 錦標賽
title.en: Season 2 | Sacc Usui V2 Counter-Clockwise Championship

summary.zh: 第二賽季第 4 站，使用 Sacc 碓冰 V2 的 Counter-Clockwise 路線。開始時間、詳細賽制、車輛限制與報到方式待主辦公告。
summary.en: Season 2 Round 4 on the Sacc Usui V2 counter-clockwise route. Start time, detailed format, vehicle restrictions, and check-in details are to be announced.

summary.zh: 定峰是節奏變化明顯的山道，包含大量連續彎、中高速路段、減速帶與技術區。穩定的路線、檔位、煞車點、抓地與出彎節奏比單一彎道的極限速度更重要。
summary.en: Sadamine combines linked corners, medium-to-high-speed sections, speed bumps, and technical zones. Consistent lines, gearing, braking, grip, and exits matter more than a single-corner peak.

summary.zh: FoxBG 製作的 Momiji 同時支援甩尾車與抓地車，適合挑戰山道節奏、連續彎、乾淨過彎與完賽穩定性。活動期間可不限次數挑戰，以世界 UI 的有效時間排序。
summary.en: FoxBG's Momiji supports drift and grip cars and rewards rhythm, linked-corner control, clean lines, and consistency. Drivers could make unlimited attempts during the session, ranked by valid world-UI times.

summary.zh: 依主辦公告與既有對戰資料重建；共 5 位選手參賽，採單淘汰賽制並設季軍戰，名次以主辦公布結果為準。
summary.en: Rebuilt from the organizer announcement and existing bracket data. Five drivers competed in a single-elimination tournament with a third-place match; final placements follow the organizer's results.

summary.zh: 本活動由正式計時紀錄重建，共保留 12 筆有效嘗試，排名以每位玩家在龍溝山下行的最佳時間計算。
summary.en: Reconstructed from twelve official timing records; each driver's best valid downhill time determines the ranking.
